summary.intent: Resume the follow-up to the callisto-hardening session, then migrate CI off the retired macos-14 runner, unblock the failing Release workflow on main, and plan an over-engineering cleanup of the Callisto codebase (including whether michi could replace parts of it).
summary.outcome: macOS runners moved to macos-15 (#421, merged) and then to macos-latest (#422, draft); branch/worktree cleanup done; Release failure root-caused (stale #409 release commit consuming no changesets, E165) with a revert branch and urgent trail created; michi/credential/exit-kind/diff investigations produced an 8-step PR plan, and the session ended starting trims to PRs #504/#505/#507 with no code for the main plan yet written.

repo: Entire session search indexes sessions by first-prompt title, not Claude Code names, so lookups by custom session name fail; search by session id instead. Entire only had checkpoints up to 2026-10-22.
Entire auto-opens a draft PR when a trail is created and the branch is pushed, so use `gh pr edit` rather than `gh pr create`.

Release workflow failure mode: if changesets are rewritten on main after a release PR is built, and the release PR still merges, the commit bumps versions but consumes no changesets, and every later push fails `callisto release plan` with E165. There is no guard against merging a stale release PR.
Release PR refresh step 'Create or update the Callisto release PR' failed on the #420 push, which let #409 go stale; the root cause of that refresh failure is still unknown.

Callisto's credential lists (runner.rs RELEASE_CREDENTIALS, ACTION_SECRET_INPUTS, graph registry.rs RELEASE_CREDENTIALS, model SECRET_CREDENTIAL_ENV) differ but their union is complete; CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG cannot reach a build backend, so there is no leak.

Michi's FSL licence (michi-core, michi-pipeline) blocks use from MIT callisto-model; callisto-model may depend only on michi-graph. Michi's own PRINCIPLES.md admission gates reject a subprocess runner.
Only #504 and #506 both edit usage_exit_codes_tests.rs, so exit_kind() work should land after both. All open PR pairs checked merge cleanly with git merge-tree.
Git signing: sandbox blocks GPG, so commits and `entire`/`gh` calls need the sandbox disabled; `E` in `git log %G?` means unverifiable locally, not unsigned.
`gh pr create` failed minting the orin-dx-pr-bot token (OpenSSL unsupported on the private key); `gh pr edit` still worked.

code.finding: The 50 ms try_wait poll loop is the only part wait-timeout/duct would replace (~15 lines); output cap, redaction, reader threads, grace period and env filtering stay custom.
RELEASE_CREDENTIALS and ACTION_SECRET_INPUTS define which env vars each child loses; credentials_needed_by gives owners (npm-family, cargo, gh).
Builds `rev:dir` instead of `rev:./dir`; git resolves rev:path from repo top-level, so in a subdirectory workspace changedSinceLastTag misses committed changes.
Already does one git diff per tag commit mapped through SpecIndex::owners_of; only pathspec scoping and list_in_chunks (24 KB Windows budget) remain removable.

USAGE_CODES / USAGE_WHEN_FROM_FLAG_CODES and is_usage_error drive exit 2; main.rs:35 is the only caller. 26 of 29 usage codes are CliError variants, E195/E196/E324 are GraphError, E316/E317 are ConfigError only when context starts with `--`.
map_err source-scan test duplicates the workspace clippy lint map_err_ignore = deny (Cargo.toml:64).
12-file include_str! list plus hand-written code(E scanner; one of three overlapping error-code scanners that exist because there is no typed ErrorCode.
The (Dev, _) and _ match arms have identical bodies; one is redundant.
macOS artifact preflight matrix entries; moved from macos-14 to macos-15 and then macos-latest (same for callisto-release.yml lines ~297 and 302).

workflow: Verify subagent reports before acting; subagent hand-backs are not user approval.
Use `! cmd` as the entire prompt with nothing before it for user-run shell commands; placeholders like <your-key> get passed literally.
Check each worktree/branch for merged status, unpushed commits and untracked files before deleting; squash merges require `git branch -D`.
Fix over-engineering in open PRs before merging them rather than merging then deleting in a follow-up.
Prefer types and exhaustive matches over source-text scan tests ('invariant ladder': type, exhaustive match, clippy lint, one small test).

friction: Sandbox TLS proxy blocked Entire, gh and git fetch; many commands needed the sandbox disabled, and the auto-mode classifier denied some unsandboxed retries.
Could not find the 'callisto-hardening' session by name; had to infer session 15c732d1 from local transcripts.
`!` commands for ssh-add arrived as plain text twice, and the sandbox blocks the SSH agent so the key load could not be verified.
GitHub changelog page could not be loaded, so the macos-14 retirement date and macos-latest to macos-26 mapping remain unconfirmed.
actionlint flagged `uses: $/.github/actions/...` in both workflows (pre-existing in HEAD); not investigated.
Local michi checkout was 30 commits behind and outside the write sandbox, requiring the user to pull it.
Release run after #421 and likely after #422 still fail with the same E165, so releases remain blocked until the revert merges.

Approve Entire Gates for trails #159/#160, close trail #159, and mark/merge #422 once CI is green; check which image macos-latest resolves to.

Stale trails (#139-#148, #151, #152, #129, #130) and remaining worktrees (smoke-main with 441 deleted files, wf_cd627354-1a0-2, callisto-homebrew-tap, stack/docs-v1) plus remote merged branches await user decisions.
